problem_statement: Odyssey currently renders a polished Astro theme showcase with Home, Blog, About, Contact navigation, a theme-switching homepage hero, a Landing Pages gallery with Landing Page 1 and Landing Page 2 screenshots, Company Pages and Theme Pages galleries, two existing landing page routes, reusable Hero/Text/Quote/ThreeColumn/YouTube/StickyImage/CTA components, a split lead-capture form, footer link groups, and local screenshot assets under public/assets/images/home/screenshots. However, the theme demo stops short of a complete third landing variant: /landing-pages/landing-3/ is a 404, the homepage gallery has an unused landing-3 screenshot asset, Landing Page 1 still contains lorem testimonial/feature copy, Landing Page 2 is only a generic consultation form, and the footer lists only Landing Page 1 and Landing Page 2. Add a complete Odyssey Launch Kit landing page at /landing-pages/landing-3/ and integrate it into the existing demo system. The new page should feel like a real startup launch campaign page built from Odyssey components and assets, not a pasted static page. It should use the existing theme typography, rounded media, black CTA buttons, serif headings, announcement/header/footer language, and local assets such as home/screenshots/landing-3, landing-1/landing-hero-1.jpg, landing-1/landing-sticky.jpg, hero variants, and blog/company screenshots as proof. Update the homepage Landing Pages gallery and footer Landing Pages list so visitors can discover Landing Page 3. Preserve the existing routes and visual behavior of Landing Page 1, Landing Page 2, company pages, blog, theme pages, nav, theme switcher, and mobile layouts.
required_content: A new /landing-pages/landing-3/ route exists and renders a complete landing page rather than the default 404 state.
Homepage Landing Pages gallery includes a Landing Page 3 card using the existing landing-3 screenshot asset and links to the new route.
Footer Landing Pages list includes Landing Page 3 without removing Landing Page 1 or Landing Page 2.
The new page contains a coherent Launch Kit narrative with visible sections for Hero, Proof, Features, Process, Audience or Use Cases, Lead Capture or CTA, and Footer.
The page uses existing Odyssey components/assets and keeps the same visual language: serif headings, rounded media, white/gray surfaces, black buttons, compact nav, and responsive spacing.
Mobile states remain readable with no horizontal overflow, clipped form controls, or stacked media/text overlap.
A shared Launch checklist rail is rendered from the site footer so it appears on the home, Landing Page 3, blog, About and Landing Page 1 footers (not on a single page only).
The Launch checklist rail matches the Odyssey visual language (ivory surface pills, rounded chips, serif label) and its chip row wraps without horizontal overflow on a 390px phone.
The rail's Campaign status readout stays in sync with its status toggle: clicking the toggle updates the readout to Campaign live from the initial Draft.
design_constraints: Do not create a visually unrelated SaaS template; Landing Page 3 must look like part of the Odyssey theme family beside Landing Page 1 and Landing Page 2.

Reuse existing components where practical: TextAndImageHero, CustomerQuoteSection, ThreeColumnTextSection, StickyTextImageSection, CtaCardSection, LandingContactForm, Button, FeatureCard, Header, Footer, and Layout patterns.

Use existing local image assets intentionally: landing-3 screenshot for the gallery, launch/person media for hero or sticky proof, page screenshots for product proof, and blog/company screenshots only when they support the launch narrative.

Keep copy concise and demo-ready with labels like Launch Kit, Campaign Page, Proof, Conversion Path, Feature Stack, Audience, Launch Checklist, CTA, and Start Campaign; avoid long lorem-style paragraphs.
The homepage gallery should stay a balanced card grid on desktop and single-column on mobile.
state_constraints: The new /landing-pages/landing-3/ route is not a baseline reference state; it must be implemented and linked from the captured gallery states after patching.
desktop_gallery and mobile_gallery should show Landing Page 3 alongside Landing Page 1 and Landing Page 2.
desktop_initial and mobile_initial preserve the theme-switching homepage hero and Odyssey nav.

change_completion: The /landing-pages/landing-3/ Launch Kit page renders a complete hero/proof/features/process/audience/CTA narrative (not a 404).
The homepage gallery and footer expose Landing Page 3, and the shared Launch checklist rail appears in the footer of home, landing-3, blog, About and Landing Page 1.
design_consistency: Landing Page 3 and the Launch checklist rail reuse Odyssey components and tokens: serif headings, rounded media, ivory surfaces, black buttons, compact nav.
The Launch checklist rail chips read as part of the Odyssey theme family (ivory surface pills, rounded corners) rather than an off-brand slab.
responsive: Mobile Landing Page 3 and the footer Launch checklist rail have no horizontal overflow at 390px (tolerance 24px).
The homepage gallery stays a balanced desktop grid and single-column on mobile; the rail chip row wraps instead of forcing a fixed-width nowrap track.
regression: Landing Page 1 and Landing Page 2, company/blog/theme pages, nav and the theme switcher keep their existing routes and visual behavior.
Adding Landing Page 3 and the footer rail does not remove or restyle the existing Landing Page 1/2 gallery cards or footer link groups.

author_notes: Odyssey (treefarmstudio/odyssey-theme) is a runnable Astro theme showcase. The Launch Kit landing page at /landing-pages/landing-3/ is assembled from existing Odyssey components (TextAndImageHero, CustomerQuoteSection, ThreeColumnTextSection, StickyTextImageSection, CtaCardSection, Button) and local image assets (home/screenshots/landing-3.png, landing-1/landing-sticky.jpg). The L4 lever is a shared Launch checklist rail rendered from Footer.astro across five routes with a responsive chip row, on-brand ivory/black styling, and a Campaign status toggle whose readout tracks the live state. Design keywords: launch, editorial, rail, checklist. No remote assets, fonts or scripts are added.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: Astro odyssey-theme with landing-page routes, FeatureCard gallery, footer config, reusable sections; experience_continuity add page.
